summary: A game where you shoot balls to break bricks.
description:
If you love classic brick-breaking games, don't miss Brick Breaking Dash!
Clear stages using laser beams, missiles, and special objects. Smash through bricks with explosive action and relieve all your stress!

[How to Play]
- Find the best position and angle to hit each brick by aiming with your finger.
- Hit as many balls against the bricks as possible to deal massive damage.
- Develop an effective strategy by considering the number of balls you have and the bricks' health.
- When the number on a brick reaches zero, it will be destroyed.
- The game ends if the bricks reach the bottom line.

[Features]
- The physics engine is optimized to make collisions and bounces feel natural.
- A convenient control environment allows you to focus on the game.
- Play with just one finger.
- No time limits or energy bars, so you can play anytime, anywhere.
- Play offline without needing a network connection.
- Endless fun is provided with massive stages and various content.
- Enjoy today's quiz, 100-ball mode, and classic mode.
- Special objects appear to make the game even more exciting.
- Earn stars to challenge the top rankings and receive rewards.
- You can change the ball skins for more variety in game play.

[Special Objects]
- Healer Brick: Restores the health of bricks.
- Bomb Brick: Destroys all bricks in the direction indicated when it explodes.
- Barrier Brick: Blocks the penetration effect of laser beams and bomb bricks.
- Regeneration Brick: If not destroyed in one hit, its health regenerates to its original state.
- Splash Brick: When hit, it turns into a splash ball that damages nearby bricks.
- Absorbing Brick: Absorbs balls when hit.
- Moving Brick: Changes direction and moves left or right with each turn.
